name: IconRegistryProvider
summary: Hands the icon drawings to every piece below it, so an icon is only bundled when the app imports it. Native only.

a11y.apg: No role: it renders no element. An Icon whose name is not in the registry draws nothing and warns once in development.

props.name: registry
props.description: The map from icon name to drawing, made with criarRegistroDeIcones from the icons the app imports one by one.

props.name: children
props.description: The part of the app that reads the registry.
